title: Can the hit structure predict the next pose?
subtitle: CDK2 · 1H1Q/2A6 is the only starting structure · later crystals appear only after each prediction is frozen

sources.label: Davies et al. · purine CDK2 inhibitor design

overlay6cp.coordinateLabel: HOLDOUT OPEN · after Agent API freeze

overlayN76.coordinateLabel: HOLDOUT OPEN · after Agent API freeze

cues.title: Start with the hit—and nothing else
cues.body: The only coordinate-bearing input is 2A6 bound to CDK2 in 1H1Q. Later compound graphs are allowed; later protein and ligand coordinates are locked.

cues.title: The first decision is local
cues.body: Add chlorine at the registered meta position. The camera is now locked on the edit site and will not orbit or chase the rest of the molecule.
cues.detail: Graph edit only · H → Cl · no 1H1R coordinates

cues.title: Agent API predicts 6CP
cues.body: designCampaign.applyStep builds the chloro analogue; pose.refine searches 64 candidates and pose.apply commits rank 1 while the inherited hit core remains fixed.
cues.detail: Agent API sequences 6–8 · purple is prediction

cues.title: Freeze before looking
cues.body: The complete predicted ligand and pocket are serialized and hashed. At this frame, the 1H1R holdout is still unopened.

cues.title: Now reveal 1H1R
cues.body: The graph was right, but a symmetry-equivalent atom map put chlorine on the opposite spatial side of the phenyl ring. That discrete choice could not be repaired with the inherited core frozen.
cues.detail: Holdout opened after freeze · ligand RMSD 1.83 Å · edited region 5.71 Å

cues.title: Do not promote the crystal to a reference
cues.body: The orange holdout disappears. The second design step starts from the frozen purple 6CP prediction—not from the newly seen 1H1R pose.
cues.detail: Agent API sequence 14 · pose.captureReference on predicted 6CP

cues.title: Second local edit: replace Cl
cues.body: The next graph replaces chlorine with sulfonamide. Because the starting prediction chose the wrong spatial meta side, this edit inherits that discrete mapping choice.
cues.detail: Graph edit only · Cl → SO₂NH₂ · no 1OIU coordinates

cues.title: Agent API predicts N76
cues.body: The same public action path builds, searches, and commits the sulfonamide from the frozen predicted 6CP reference.
cues.detail: Agent API sequences 15–17 · purple is prediction

cues.title: Freeze again before looking
cues.body: The second prediction is serialized and hashed under the same hit-only boundary. No later crystal has entered the trajectory as a coordinate reference.

cues.title: Now reveal 1OIU
cues.body: The sulfonamide crystal occupies the opposite spatial side. The inherited scaffold remains close, while the edited region records the propagated mapping failure.
cues.detail: Holdout opened after freeze · ligand RMSD 2.67 Å · edited region 6.51 Å

cues.title: The useful result is the failure mode
cues.body: CDK2 itself barely rearranged. The missing capability is prospective enumeration and pocket scoring of symmetry-equivalent atom mappings—not hindsight from either later crystal.
